response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform expertise; their work is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, with minimal evidence of cloud compute leadership or distributed systems architecture aligned with the job's core needs.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility and open-source contributions
Demonstrated mentoring and workshop leadership in testing and DevOps
Extensive experience with distributed systems and high-throughput services
concerns: Only 1-2 years of C++ exposure, far below the 8-year minimum requirement
No clear evidence of cloud compute platform ownership or leadership
Lacks documented experience with cloud architecture balancing short/long-term needs
